why: Image 1 holds together as one coherent room: clean wood and concrete, believable pools of light from the globe lamps and pendants, and a strong receding perspective with no artifacts, even if it reads a little too pristine and empty. Image 2 has more grain and life, but up close its long-exposure patrons are smeared orange-and-grey blobs with no believable anatomy and the floor turns into a blotchy, painterly texture, so it looks retouched rather than photographed.
